summary: Tested the keuangan features end to end (backend pytest + Playwright UI): login password eye toggle, staff gaji_bulanan (create/list/prompt update), Input Pengeluaran (validation, CRUD, total, period filters), Gaji (pemungut select auto-fill, 'Gaji [nama] bulan YYYY-MM', 409 duplicate, 422 when gaji is 0), Harga Barang admin CRUD shown on Home section and the /harga-barang public page (section hidden when empty), exports for 3 kinds x 2 formats x 3 periods (xlsx contents checked: Total Pengeluaran, rekap rows = payments + pengeluaran, last row SALDO AKHIR = pemasukan - pengeluaran), and RBAC (staff gets 403 on the API, no nav links, redirect to /dashboard, no export buttons). Regression tests for kuitansi and pasar_flow pass. All requested functionality works. Only minor UI and code-quality issues found.

minor.issue: Field validation errors come back as raw English pydantic text (e.g. 'String should have at least 2 characters') and the toast shows them as-is in an Indonesian UI.

issues: The select-pemungut text, e.g. 'TEST_UI Pemungut (Rp 2.750.000/bln)', overflows its grid cell and overlaps the Keterangan input and its placeholder. Add w-full min-w-0 to the select (and truncate), or give the pemungut column more space.
The Sonner toast (top-right) covers the clock and the user name/avatar in the top bar while it is shown. Minor.
In edit mode the submit button still shows the Plus icon with the text 'Simpan'. Minor.

action_items: Fix the select-pemungut overflow in the InputPengeluaran form (w-full min-w-0 / truncate)
Optional: translate or override pydantic min_length messages for Harga Barang and Pengeluaran so toasts are in Indonesian
Optional: filter inactive staff (aktif=false) out of the select-pemungut list
critical_code_review_comments: UserManager: switching role to super_admin disables the gaji input but keeps the earlier gaji_bulanan value in the form state, so a super_admin can be created with gaji_bulanan > 0. Reset gaji_bulanan to 0 when role != staff (or have the backend force 0 for super_admin).
InputPengeluaran: the pemungut list includes inactive (aktif=false) staff, and the backend _gaji does not check aktif either.
ExportLaporan.unduh: URL.revokeObjectURL is called right after a.click(), which can cancel the download in Safari/Firefox (defer it with setTimeout). A fetch network error is not caught (no toast).
HargaBarangAdmin: the hapus mutation has no onError toast.
Gaji uniqueness is enforced by the partial unique index gaji_unik (pemungut_id, periode_gaji) on kategori=gaji. This works (409).

test_pasar_flow.py leaves TEST_ data behind (pedagang, lapak, sewa, payments) and creates a sewa on a seeded pedagang (NGURAH WIJAYA). Leftovers from earlier runs (TEST_LapakFlow/TEST_LapakPub lapak from 2026-11-02) are still in the DB. Its fixtures need teardown.
